mapper.select: SELECT MIN(assignment.study_date) FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN user_quiz_assignments assignment ON assignment.user_id = qa.user_id AND assignment.quiz_set_id = qa.quiz_set_id WHERE qa.user_id = #{userId} AND qa.attempt_type = 'PRIMARY'

SELECT assignment.study_date AS challenge_date, (qa.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS completed_date, qa.score, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attempt_answers aa WHERE aa.attempt_id = qa.id AND aa.is_correct = FALSE ) AS wrong_count, COUNT(ar.id) FILTER (WHERE ar.review_status = 'RECOVERED') AS recovered_count FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN user_quiz_assignments assignment ON assignment.user_id = qa.user_id AND assignment.quiz_set_id = qa.quiz_set_id LEFT JOIN answer_reviews ar ON ar.source_attempt_id = qa.id AND ar.user_id = qa.user_id WHERE qa.user_id = #{userId} AND qa.attempt_type = 'PRIMARY' AND assignment.study_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY assignment.study_date, qa.id, qa.score, qa.completed_at ORDER BY assignment.study_date
